szoveg_eredeti:
Put Gemini to work for you with Tasks.

While Chat is for quick back-and-forth answers, Tasks are for longer projects and recurring schedules. 

Beginning today, Tasks are now free of charge for hundreds of millions of eligible users, starting in the U.S., JP, KR, CA, AU & IN. 🧵
